summary: Backend 8/8 pytest tests pass end-to-end (auth register/login/me/delete, item CRUD + duplicate + list pagination + tag/intent filter, retry-enrich, 5-intent collections). YouTube and Instagram enrichment through the 6-stage scraper + Gemini 3 Flash chain returns real enriched titles/summaries/tags (Phase 1 exit criteria met at API layer; also verified via UI vault tiles). Frontend (Expo web preview) verified: auth screen → vault masonry → item detail with hero + AI summary + edit mode saved (title & intent persisted via API check) → Collections tab shows 5 intents with counts and filters to Watch → Profile shows email/Free plan/daily-AI ring (1/5) → Privacy & Terms legal pages render. CRITICAL: the AddSheet (`@gorhom/bottom-sheet` `BottomSheetModal`) does NOT open on the Expo web preview (invisible after tapping +), which blocks the in-app URL save flow on web; on native (Expo Go / iOS / Android) this should work but the web preview URL used for testing/demoing is broken. A separate minor issue was fixed: unhandled `Clipboard.getStringAsync()` rejection on web caused a LogBox red screen when opening AddSheet — patched with `.catch()`. Deprecated packages detected: none of the flagged ones (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) are present.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the center + tab (`add-tab-button`) calls `openAddSheet()` and mounts <AddSheet/>, but the BottomSheetModal never becomes visible on Expo web preview — no url input, no close button, no backdrop. The half-sheet URL-save flow (Phase 1 core loop) is unusable on the web preview. `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` has known web-support gaps; consider swapping to a web-compatible sheet or a plain Modal on Platform.OS==='web'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AddSheet.tsx (BottomSheetModal usage).

issues: Tabs are icon-only (no text labels), so screen readers and automated tests can't locate 'Collections'/'Profile' by name. Consider adding accessibilityLabel or short labels for clarity.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking; likely coming from a dependency (e.g. bottom-sheet / gesture-handler shadows). Reference: seen in Expo web console.

action_items: HIGH: Fix AddSheet on Expo web — @gorhom/bottom-sheet does not render on web. Either (a) render a plain <Modal> or a full screen on Platform.OS==='web', or (b) migrate to a web-compatible sheet lib. Without this the Phase 1 save-URL loop cannot be used from the web preview URL.
LOW: Investigate the two deprecation warnings (`pointerEvents` prop and `shadow*` style props) — likely fixed by upgrading gesture-handler / bottom-sheet or migrating internal styles to `boxShadow`.
LOW (nice-to-have): Consider adding a fallback if `EMERGENT_LLM_KEY` is missing so items still save with signals as `enrichment_status='manual'` — already handled, but log a warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py `get_current_user` raises 401 with HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) — good. But FastAPI returns 403 by default when the header is missing with HTTPBearer even when auto_error=False in older versions; tests accept both 401/403.

items.py duplicate-save check compares `original_url` exactly (post normalisation is only `strip()` + adding https://). URLs with tracking params or trailing slashes may not be caught as duplicates. Consider canonicalising (strip query params like utm_*, trim trailing slash) before compare.

items.py `saves_today` uses `datetime.fromisoformat('YYYY-MM-DD')` which yields a naive datetime while `created_at` is timezone-aware UTC — Mongo comparison still works with pymongo, but this is fragile. Prefer explicit UTC midnight.

ai.py enrichment silently swallows exceptions and returns None; the caller still saves with `enrichment_status='manual'|'failed'` — good UX. But it would help to log the exception with the URL for debuggability (currently `logging.warning('enrichment failed: %s', e)` — no URL context).
AddSheet.tsx clipboard read had no `.catch()`; fixed by testing agent (unhandled rejection was surfacing as a LogBox red screen on Expo web dev).
Frontend BASE URL correctly uses `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` — good.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/AddSheet.tsx (added .catch() to Clipboard.getStringAsync to prevent unhandled rejection / LogBox on web)

Reuse the `registered_user` / `auth_headers` fixtures — they create a fresh TEST_ account per session and clean up via DELETE /auth/me. The Phase 1 exit criteria (YouTube+Instagram real summaries) is verified at API layer + confirmed rendering in the vault masonry UI. rca_of_issue: Bug: Tapping + on web preview does not open the AddSheet. RCA: `@gorhom/bottom-sheet`'s BottomSheetModal relies on react-native-gesture-handler / reanimated APIs whose web implementations are incomplete; the modal mounts but never becomes visible (no url input, no backdrop). Repro: on web preview, login → tap `add-tab-button` → no sheet appears. Mitigation: on `Platform.OS==='web'`, render a lightweight React Native <Modal> (or an Expo Router modal screen) housing the same form and result stages, keeping shared state via useVault. Secondary bug (fixed by tester): `Clipboard.getStringAsync()` in AddSheet's useEffect rejected on web (permission denied) with no `.catch()` → LogBox red-screen overlay was shown over the (dismissed) sheet in dev. Fix applied at /app/frontend/src/components/AddSheet.tsx (added .catch that no-ops).
